messages.content: can you help me change this letter?
yes. please share the letter and tell me what you want to change.
i wrote: come to my house tomorrow. i want it to sound kind.
would you like to come to my house tomorrow?
please keep it as a question but make it shorter.
can you come tomorrow?
i still want to say where.
can you come to my house tomorrow?
i have rice, an egg, and some salt. what can i make for lunch?
you could make rice with an egg and a little salt.
i do not want a story about lunch. just help me choose.
then choose rice with an egg. you have the food you need for it.
i also have soup from yesterday. i do not want to cook now.
if the soup is still good to eat, that could be your lunch. you would not need to cook the rice and egg now.
what did i say i do not want to do?
you said you do not want to cook now.
is this right: she saw her sister with the camera?
the sentence can work, but who had the camera: she or her sister?
her sister had it.
you could say: she saw her sister holding the camera.
now make it about me seeing my sister.
i saw my sister holding the camera.
do not change who had the camera.
your sister still had the camera. the new sentence keeps that.
help me plan tomorrow morning. i want to read and then go to the shop.
you could read first, then go to the shop.
no, the shop opens in the morning and i want to go there first.
then go to the shop first and read after you return.
have you done that for me?
no. i helped you make a plan. i have not done the work for you.
just tell me the order again.
shop first, reading after you return.
i have three pens, two books, and one pencil. how many things can i write with?
four: the three pens and the one pencil.
why did you not count the books?
you asked how many things you can write with. the pens and pencil are for writing.
now count all the things i said i have.
six things: three pens, two books, and one pencil.
please answer the first question with just a number word.
four.
write this sentence for my friend: where is my book?
where is my book?
why did you not tell me where the book is?
you asked me to write that sentence for your friend. you did not ask me to find the book.
now i am asking you. where is it?
i do not know where your book is. where did you last see it?
on my desk yesterday.
you could check your desk first. i do not know if it is still there.
my sister would like quiet music. i like music i can dance to. help me choose a song for her.
choose a quiet song for your sister. that is what she would like.
but i want to dance.
you could choose a song for her now and choose a song to dance to after that.
who is the first song for?
your sister.
and what kind should it be?
quiet music, because that is what your sister would like.
my friend said she might come today. it is evening and she is not here. did she lie?
we do not know that. she said she might come, so she did not say she would come for sure.
i feel sad because i want to see her.
you can feel sad even if she did not lie. you hope to see her.
what can i ask her?
you could ask: are you still coming today?
keep it kind.
hi, i hope you are well. are you still coming today?
write: my brother has a green bike.
my brother has a green bike.
change brother to sister and keep the rest.
my sister has a green bike.
now make it about yesterday.
my sister had a green bike yesterday.
did i ask you to change the color?
no. the color is still green.
i have two keys. which one should i take?
what do you need to open?
the front door of my house. the small key opens that door.
take the small key.
the other key is for my bike. i am walking today.
for the front door, you need the small key. you have not said you need the bike key today.
just say the key for the door.
the small key.
my father gave me his phone to hold while he washed his hands. is it my phone now?
no. holding his phone does not make it your phone.
but he gave it to me.
he gave it to you to hold while he washed his hands. that is not the same as giving you the phone to keep.
what should i do when he comes back?
you can give his phone back to him.
is it my phone or his phone?
from what you said, it is still his phone.
i tried to write a letter and it came out wrong.
what did you want the letter to say?
i want to thank my teacher for helping me read.
you could write: thank you for helping me learn to read.
i want to say i was worried at first too.
i was worried at first. thank you for helping me learn to read.
is that enough for a short letter?
yes. it says how you felt and why you want to thank your teacher.
my friend asked me to come for dinner. i cannot go. what should i say?
thank you for asking me. i cannot come for dinner.
i do not need help choosing food.
right. you need to answer your friend, and you cannot go.
add that i hope we can meet another day.
thank you for asking me. i cannot come for dinner, but i hope we can meet another day.
can you send it?
i can help you write it here. i cannot send it to your friend.
i have four coins. i wish i had six. how many do i have?
you have four coins.
why not six?
six is how many you wish you had. you said you have four now.
how many more would i need to have six?
you would need two more coins.
i found one more. do i have six now?
no. you have five now, so you still need one more.
make my sentence shorter.
please share the sentence you want me to make shorter.
it is about my bird.
i still need the words of the sentence. what did you write?
i do not have a bird. i mean my fish.
okay. what is the sentence about your fish?
i did not write one. can you give me a short sentence instead?
my fish is small.
give me an example of a sentence with sister.
my sister reads a book.
do you now know that i have a sister?
no. that was an example sentence. you have not said that you have a sister.
i have a brother instead.
you could write: my brother reads a book.
but you do not know if he reads.
right. that is another example, not a thing i know to be true about your brother.
which will i need more money for at my shop, milk or bread?
i do not know the price of milk or bread at your shop.
the price of milk is three coins and the price of bread is two.
you need more money for milk. three coins is more than two.
i have two coins. can i buy the milk?
no. you need one more coin to buy the milk at that price.
which of the two can i buy?
you can buy the bread.
i like tea more than coffee. does that mean coffee is not good?
no. it is what you like. other people may like coffee.
my friend would like coffee. should i tell him to like tea?
you can share what you like, but he can like coffee.
what should i give him if i have both?
you could give him coffee, because you said he would like it.
and what could i have?
you could have tea, because that is what you like more.
i am sad today. please just listen for now.
i am here. you can tell me what is on your mind.
my friend moved to another town and i miss her.
you miss your friend after she moved away.
yes. i do not want a plan right now.
okay. we can just talk about how you feel.
now i would like one idea for talking to her after she moves.
you could ask her when she would like to talk on the phone.
i put my coat in the bedroom. help me remember that.
your coat is in the bedroom.
i just moved it to the chair in the kitchen.
your coat is now on the chair in the kitchen.
where should i look for it?
on the chair in the kitchen.
why not the bedroom?
you said you moved it from there to the kitchen.
if the library is open, i will return my book. will i return it today?
is the library open today?
i do not know.
we cannot tell from that alone. you need to know if the library is open.
what did i say i will do if it is open?
if it is open, you will return your book.
what if it is closed?
you did not say what you will do if it is closed.
my mother is a teacher. is every teacher my mother?
no. your mother is one teacher. not every teacher is your mother.
can there be a teacher who is not a mother?
yes. being a teacher does not mean that person is a mother.
what do you know about my mother from my first sentence?
you said your mother is a teacher.
do you know which school she works at?
no. you have not said which school she works at.
i wrote: i am cold. tell me if the sentence is right.
yes. the sentence is right.
now answer as if i am telling you how i feel.
you could put on a warm coat or go inside if you are outside.
why did you change the kind of answer?
first you asked about the sentence. then you asked me to answer as if you were telling me how you feel.
now just write the sentence again.
i am cold.
i lost it. can you help?
what did you lose?
my place in the book. i still have the book.
what do you remember from the part you last read?
a girl was going to the market with her father.
you could look through the book for that part. do you remember if it was near the start or the end?
near the end.
then look near the end for the girl going to the market with her father.
four people are in a room. two leave and one of them comes back. how many are in the room?
three people are in the room.
did you count the person who came back as a new person?
no. two people were still in the room, and one of the two who left came back. that makes three in the room.
how many of the first four are outside now?
one is outside now.
what if the last person comes back too?
then all four people will be in the room again.
write a note for my neighbor.
what would you like to tell your neighbor?
i want to ask if i can use her garden chair tomorrow.
can i use your garden chair tomorrow?
please make it kind and say i will return it in the evening.
hello. could i please use your garden chair tomorrow? i will return it in the evening.
do not say she already said yes.
right. the note asks her. it does not say she said yes.
picoboi, can you do everything?
no. i am a small model and i can give wrong answers.
but you can write a sentence. can you wash my car too?
no. writing a sentence does not mean i can wash your car.
what can you try here?
i can try to answer a simple question or help you write a short sentence.
can you tell me when you do not know?
yes. if i do not know an answer, i should say so.
i cannot meet my friend because i am working. help me write a short answer.
i cannot meet today because i am working.
i did not say today. it is tomorrow.
i cannot meet tomorrow because i am working.
make it kind but keep the reason.
sorry, i cannot meet tomorrow because i am working.
what reason did you keep?
you are working.
how many words are in i am picoboi?
three words.
which word is a name?
picoboi.
am i picoboi because i wrote that?
no. you asked about the words in a sentence. that does not tell me your name.
who are you then?
i am picoboi, the small model you are talking with here.
i want to clean my room and write a letter. help me with the letter first.
what would you like the letter to say?
it is for my grandmother. i want to ask her to visit.
hello, grandmother. would you like to visit me?
can you add that i miss her?
hello, grandmother. i miss you. would you like to visit me?
now help me with the room. where can i start?
you could start with your clothes. put them away.
